description: Form controls under an inherited line-height: 32px (BLITZ-GAPS, fixed in the fork: form-control line height): buttons at two font sizes, a select, a text input and a text area take line-height: normal from the UA sheet, as Chromium's controls do through their UA font, so their boxes are as tall as Chromium's. Rows have a fixed height: text inputs and text areas keep the separate, smaller text input line height difference (about 1px per line, within the geometry tolerance), which would otherwise add up down the page
